title: Barish ne Test dhoya… aur ODI cricket paida hua 🌧️ #shorts
facebook_title: Rain washed out a Test, and ODI cricket was born
caption:
Barish ne ek Test match dho diya… aur ODI cricket paida ho gaya! 🌧️

January 1971, Melbourne: Australia vs England ka Test barish se radd hua, to darshakon ke liye 40–40 over ka ek din ka match rakha gaya. Ummeed 20 hazaar logon ki thi, aaye 46 hazaar. Australia 5 wicket se jeeta — aur yahi bana ODI number 1.

Aapka favourite format: Test, ODI ya T20? Comment mein bataiye! 👇
